hero.title: Share your “To Watch” lists across Emby accounts
hero.lede: PlaySync automatically removes watched media from a shared playlist and syncs playback progress between its members — so no one loses track of what's been seen.
problems.title: A shared “to watch” list quickly becomes unmanageable
problems.intro: On a personal or family Emby server, every account keeps its own list. Without coordination, it fills up with duplicates, oversights and media already watched.
problems.c1.title: Duplicates and oversights
problems.c1.text: Everyone adds the same titles without knowing what other household members have already watched.
problems.c2.title: Manual cleanup
problems.c2.text: A watched item stays in the shared list — someone has to remember to remove it for everyone.
problems.c3.title: Lost progress
problems.c3.text: Switching account or device mid-watch loses the playback position.
solutions.title: What PlaySync does
solutions.intro: PlaySync builds on Emby's native playlist sharing and adds automatic “watched” handling, toggled per playlist with tags.
solutions.c1.title: Native sharing, no friction
solutions.c1.text: Sharing goes through Emby's standard menu. The permission the owner needs is granted automatically to every account.
solutions.c2.title: Automatic removal on watched
solutions.c2.text: The remove-si-lu tag: once a member finishes a title, it disappears from the list for everyone.
solutions.c3.title: Shared progress
solutions.c3.text: The propager-lu tag: the watched flag and playback position are copied to other members — start on one account, continue on another.
solutions.c4.title: Built-in diagnostics
solutions.c4.text: Decision log and in-memory state available to an admin; behaviour verified at scale (10+ playlists, 5+ concurrent members, sub-1s latency).
solutions.c5.title: Dedicated user page
solutions.c5.text: A “PlaySync” page in Emby's user menu (Avatar → PlaySync) to manage members and sharing options without touching tags: add, set Read/Write level, remove, toggle switches — in French and English.
architecture.title: One plugin, no extra service
architecture.intro: PlaySync runs inside the Emby Server process itself: it listens to native events (playback, playlists) and reacts accordingly, with no database and no separate server.
architecture.stack.noui: No dedicated frontend — Emby config page
architecture.requirement: Requirement: an existing Emby server (tested against SDK 4.9.3.0). The plugin installs on the instance already in place, no extra infrastructure needed.
deployment.title: Install PlaySync
deployment.binaries.row_cmd: Copy into Emby's plugins/ folder (root, not a subfolder), then restart.
deployment.binaries.link: Latest version on the GitHub Releases page.
deployment.config.intro: Configuration happens on the plugin's own page (Emby dashboard) and via tags on each playlist — no separate file to edit.
deployment.config.row1: Automatically grants the sharing permission to every account
deployment.config.row2: Playlist tag — removes a watched item for all members
deployment.config.row3: Playlist tag — propagates the watched flag and playback position
deployment.config.row4: Enables the log and state available to an admin
footer.tagline: PlaySync — community plugin for Emby, not affiliated with Emby.
